name: remotion-video
description: Cass Remotion brand films and website background assets

scripts.render: remotion render CassSizzle out/cass-sizzle.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p --muted
scripts.render:web-asset: remotion render CassSizzle out/cass-sizzle-web.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 23 --pixel-format yuv420p --muted --width 960 --height 720 --x264-preset medium --gop 60
scripts.render:legacy-web-asset: remotion render CassSizzleLegacy out/cass-sizzle-legacy-web.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 23 --pixel-format yuv420p --muted --width 960 --height 720 --x264-preset medium --gop 60
scripts.render:web-preview: remotion render CassSizzleWebPreview out/cass-sizzle-web-preview.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p --muted
scripts.render:logo: remotion render CassLogoReveal out/cass-logo-reveal.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p --muted
scripts.render:logo:web: remotion render CassLogoReveal ../src/assets/cass-logo-reveal.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --pixel-format yuv420p --muted --x264-preset slow --gop 120
